importOtherAccountTooltip:
{HEADER}Import only from your own account{/HEADER}{BODY}kurzdor stores his vehicles by inventory id. Those ids only mean something inside one account.
On a different account the same ids belong to different vehicles, so an import would put the equipment on the wrong tanks.

How to get the saved equipments anyway:
1. Run this mod on the original account and import the saved equipment there.
2. Then, from this account, import that account's file – via "Import saved configs from another of your accounts".{/BODY}
